mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 52 degrees with overcast conditions at Badger Prairie County Park.

The city wants to remind everyone about two important updates. First, winter street parking rules start November 20, requiring alternate-side parking until April. Second, the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do, with the Dane County Farmers Market happening today, along with live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join in for trivia at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's this coming Tuesday, November 4.
In a note regarding public safety, on October 23, officers made contact with two juveniles riding eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents.
Culver's will be serving up their delicious Mint Explosion today, so be sure to stop by when they open today at 10:00 AM.
